purpose: T70 haunted-market material reskin of the existing arms and wizard-equipment stall.

review: The canopy emblem and blue pennant/sign are removed while the main cloth canopy and support frame remain. The same weapons, wizard goods, skull ornament and shield stay readable in the original layout.
